wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/fix_version_prelude_harness.py: """The parity gate's first run found two more preludes the harness never injected.

`version_prelude` supplies `zend_version()`, `php_sapi_name()` and `ini_restore()` — php-visible
functions the codegen suite therefore could not test at all. It takes three arguments the harness
already has, so it is wired in.

`opcache_prelude` is excluded instead, and the exclusion says why: its injection takes an opcache
manifest, preload symbols and preload statistics that the harness has no source for. The
consequence is stated rather than hidden — the functions it supplies are not covered by this suite.
"
